description: This file is a React component named CacheSettings that provides a user interface for configuring Redis cache settings, including connection details, Redis type selection, and advanced configurations. It handles loading current cache settings, testing cache connection, and saving updated settings via API calls, with UI elements like accordions, buttons, and custom fields.

methods.name: loadCacheSettings
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches cache settings from the API and updates component state accordingly.

methods.name: handleTestConnection
methods.description: Triggers a connection test to the cache using current form values, displays success or error notifications.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves updated cache settings via API call and reloads the settings.
